newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK128 mln bills, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK128 mln bills, rates steady.

text.p: Croatia's central bank auctioned 128 million kuna ($21.9 million) worth of 35- and 91-day liquidity bills at steady rates on Wednesday.
Because banks that have access to bill sales had high liquidity, volume rose from only 22.5 million issued last week.
Banks can use central bank paper as collateral for Lombard loans, granted at 11 percent.
The National Bank of Croatia also intervenes in the money market by occasionally buying or selling kuna for foreign exchange.
